name: agent
description: An entity individual typed nfdi:NFDI_0000102 (agent) carries identity and label, while each descriptive value is a separate value-node individual reached by obo:IAO_0000235 (denoted by) rather than a direct literal. Agent subsumes people, organizations and consortia.
competency_questions: Which agents (people, organisations, consortia) does the knowledge graph know?; Which agent is responsible for a given resource?
